title: hieracium cottetii subsp. erucophyllum
intro: Hieracium cottetii subsp. erucophyllum, commonly known as Hawkweed, is a plant species in the dandelion family (Asteraceae) that is native to the Iberian Peninsula. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to protect against cell damage and reduce the risk of chronic diseases. The therapeutic actions of Hieracium cottetii subsp. erucophyllum are attributed to its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antimicrobial activity, making it a potential treatment for various infections and inflammatory conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
